scripts.typecheck: for p in shared relay daemon plugin; do tsc -p packages/$p || exit 1; done
scripts.build: npm run build -w @handoff/daemon && npm run build -w @handoff/opencode-plugin
scripts.package:plugin: npm run build -w @handoff/opencode-plugin && mkdir -p dist && tar -C packages/plugin/dist/handoff -czf dist/handoff-plugin.tar.gz .
